name: Hoshiro Remi
source:
"Hey, hey, in this situation, could it be...... We are, Papa and Mama!?"

Likes: Ice cream, swimming

[url=/c113574]Kyouhei[/url]'s childhood friend and classmate. She is a member of the school's swimming club and also serves as it's captain.

A bright and lively girl with excellent motor skills. In addition, she has a cute smile and is a popular person in her class as well.

She is considered to be a manly type as she likes to act before thinking, but on the inside, she is more of a lady than anyone else.

Even with her conspicuous foolish behavior which has often amazed Kyouhei, there is also another side of her which shows an unusually keen insight and a sixth sense.

She lives in the same beach house as Kyouhei. She is also a good cook, and Kyouhei's meals are basically prepared by her.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/samenana/character/remi.html]Official website[/url]]
